reviews.review:
I can't tell you just how much I love this game so far, I have played it just a ton since buying it and it is fun when alone, but it's amazing with 1 or more friends. 

Firstly let me say I really love the devs relationship with the game's community, you can tell they are loved by those enjoying their game and I really appreciate seeing devs support a game so well because even at "Early Access" I am super pleased with everything I've seen and it just makes me so much more excited to see what else is to come. 

The game can be easy or intense, it all depends on the mission, mutators, difficulty(hazard level), and more. You'll find great intense times where a friend goes down and your partner is about to go down and lose the round and then a shield drop at the last second or an ammo drop just in time saves the team and the game. It's just beyond a good experience for me, it's both relaxing and calm, and intense and action packed all at once it just depends on what moment during the game as to which of those you'll feel. With various mission types, with a community I haven't had a negative experience yet with, and with great devs planning for more in the future I can tell this is going to be one of my favorite games of all time and it is definitely one I and my friends have to force ourselves to stop once it gets too late into the night. We always wanna play more games, I really just can't say enough how much I appreciate this game and how glad I am I got it. I haven't been able to enjoy a game this much in ages and this is such a breath of fresh air. 

I love it so much I gave them 15 extra bucks just to give them more support, and that's a first and probably last time game devs will impress me so much I just throw extra money their way to support them and their creation. 

If you love Left 4 Dead, or Warhammer Vermintide 2 then buy this...cause this is way better if you ask me. It's got the charm, mining/collecting, great environments, and ability to ramp the difficulty up for insane action...and there's more to come as they keep releasing updates.

Great work Ghost Ship, you guys are a shining example of what devs are supposed to be to gamers. I can't wait to see what's coming for this game and while I wait I'll happily sink plenty of time enjoy enjoying this title.

2/27/19 Just stepped back here to say these last updates have been really awesome, and I really appreciate the extras on the supporter edition guys. I was ok with paying for the supporter upgrade because I liked the devs dedication and appreciated them being so good with their game but I'm definitely happy to see some new swagger for those who chipped in extra for the game and it's development. Much love and respect.

As of 6/2/19 they are still working on and putting out great updates and still taking community feedback into account. They are still consistently doing great work on their game and a lot has been added since the initial review.

9/26/19 Big Update. They are still bringing quality content to this game.

11/26/21 It's been quite a while since my last update. There have been more weapons, modes, cosmetics, unlockables, events, biomes/environments, and progression items to keep options for rewards to work for as you play large in variety and in time you can continue to sink loving every minute of this game. 

The community is still in large majority friendly and fun to play with, toxic bs is very rare, and the game is still an absolute gem and a joy to play. I've had it since Early Access and it's never ceased to please me. The devs don't swim in greed, they care about their community/customers, and they give meaningful content drops in reasonable time frames. This game is a must buy at full price, on sale, whenever it is worth it.

Late Nov/Early Dec 2023. The game is still absolutely fantastic. One of the best bangs for your buck on all of steam.

This game takes a formula we all know and love and makes it exciting again. It's a ton of fun with friends and requires legitimate cooperation to survive, but does not require you to team up in Discord and use voice chat to progress.

They have been adding resources, upgrade trees, armor, weapons, and the loot grind becomes more satisfying everytime I boot it up.

This game is great, if you like coop hoard shooters then pick it up.
